name: Commission
definition: Amount of money due to a party as compensation for a service.

CommissionType.name: Commission Type
CommissionType.definition: Service for which the commission is asked or paid.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Basis upon which a commission is charged, eg, flat fee.

CommercialAgreementReference.name: Commercial Agreement Reference
CommercialAgreementReference.definition: Reference to the agreement established between the fund and another party. This element, amongst others, defines the conditions of the commissions.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Date/time at which the commission is calculated.

CommissionAmount.name: Commission Amount
CommissionAmount.definition: Commission expressed as an amount of money.

SplitRate.name: Split Rate
SplitRate.definition: Percentage of the total commission received by an intermediary.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency in which the commission has to be settled.

CommissionWaiving.name: Commission Waiving
CommissionWaiving.definition: Voluntary non-enforcement of the right to all or part of a commission.

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Trade for which commission parameters are specified.

Broker.name: Broker
Broker.definition: Broker to which a commission is paid.

CommissionPartyRole.name: Commission Party Role
CommissionPartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of commissions.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account used for the commission fees.

CorporateActionFeesAndCharges.name: Corporate Action Fees And Charges
CorporateActionFeesAndCharges.definition: Corporate action fees to which commission fees are added.
